findings.issue: Contract mandates invocation /opt/specorganon/venv/bin/python -E -s -B /delivery/lotledger.py, but Subjects.run builds subject command with /input/delivery/lotledger.py mounted at /input/delivery with -w /input/delivery and no /delivery mount. The F73 conformance gate therefore does not execute the contracted argv/path.
findings.required_change: Align contract path with evaluator mounts before freeze: either change contract to /input/delivery path or add readonly /delivery mount and invoke contracted argv in Subjects and DockerRoles test transport.

findings.issue: LotLedger freeze binds experiments/software_comparison_v3/protocol-draft.md. Any edit to that separate unregistered later-stage draft invalidates/closes lotledger-delivery-v1, coupling two identities that must stay separate.
findings.required_change: Remove software_comparison_v3 draft from LotLedger registration_source_names and source_sha256 closure; freeze it only in its own later preregistration.

findings.issue: Role parser strips ```json / ``` fences before strict JSON parsing, accepting fenced commentary despite prompt requiring ONLY the JSON object. This weakens strict JSON/types/framing for author/review packets.
findings.required_change: Reject fenced or extra-text responses as invalid role result; accept only one strict JSON object with no fences.

findings.issue: Claim that original60 recipes retain identical data/expected outputs and canonical old60 SHA is unchanged cannot be verified from this source set: no preserved original60 bytes are supplied, only the latest 73-recipe file.
findings.required_change: Supply preserved original60 canonical bytes for independent comparison or remove unchanged-SHA claim from freeze acceptance criteria; freeze only the supplied 73 with finite-coverage disclaimer.

review.oracle_audit: Checked actual bytes: contract quantity is 1..1000000000 inclusive with balances allowed beyond, not 1e6 prose error; reserved.py enforces over-max 1e9+1 and 2e9 balance; matrix is 73 with 11/10/10/13/10/19 and matrix_count 73 consistent across protocol/driver/preflight; image-users.json has uid1000 and exit 0 for both pinned images; driver imports original_profile_quota not study_campaign; empty/NUL/surrogate/64/65/from/to and no-final-LF recipes present. These do not cure the /delivery path mismatch, comparison-draft coupling, fence tolerance, or unverifiable old60 claim.
review.rationale: Source set is substantially complete and honest about six SQLite primitives, unknown tokens/money, and finite 73-recipe coverage, but exact contract-vs-execution binding, freeze scope separation, strict role framing, and preservation evidence each retain a concrete gap. Freeze must wait for coordinator fixes; no registration, generation, or comparison authorized.
